scope: Proposition 5.1 (Coulomb formula) of the manuscript “Natural Occupation Measures for Critical Square-Lattice FK Interfaces” (preprints/Natural-Occupation-Measures-for-Critical-Square-Lattice-FK-Interfaces-October-5-2026/natural-occupation-measures-critical-square-lattice-fk-interfaces.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 223 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 d0fd0c30ada6a1f0), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 32. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. statement: Fix a number p of marked points. There are b, c, ξ > 0 and a real-analytic function f on a neighborhood of [−b, b], with f(0) = 0, such that, for neutral real charges maxj |tj| ≤ b and distinct points on a tile axis satisfying max j |uj| ≤ Mn, min i̸=j |ui − uj| ≥ n1−ξ , one has log C(t; u) = p X j=1 f(tj) + 2A X i<j titj log |ui − uj| + O(n−c ), f(0) = 0. (5.1) Here the same local function f is used for every number of points, on their common small-charge neighborhood; it is independent of the geometry and of the point parities. The constants can depend on p, M and q. For either choice of sign, the corresponding multiplicative statement has analytic continuation along compact paths from zero in D± p = {t ∈ Rp : X j tj = 0, ±tj ∈ Iλ for every j}. More precisely, on a sufficiently thin complex neighborhood of each such compact path within the neutral hyperplane P j tj = 0, there is a holomorphic function Mp such that C(t; u) Y i<j |ui − uj|2Atitj = Mp(t) + O(n−c ). (5.2) The positive constants c and ξ may decrease with the path. Near zero, Mp(t) = exp( P j f(tj)). The error in (5.2) is additive; a relative error is asserted only where Mp is nonzero.
